title: Working From Home: One Year Later
body: When my company told us we could work from home permanently, I was excited. I would not have a long commute anymore, and I could sleep an hour more every morning. At first, it was great. But after a few months, I started to feel isolated. I missed the small talk in the kitchen and the quick questions to my teammates. My days also became very long because I did not have clear boundaries between work and free time. I often answered messages at ten at night. Last spring, I decided to change my routine. Now I stop working at six, and twice a week I work from a small café near my house. I still love working from home, but I have learned that I need people around me.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
questions.reference_answer: The writer likes working from home but learned that a better routine and contact with people are needed.

questions.prompt: What did the writer miss the most?
Why do you think the writer started going to a café?
questions.reference_answer: To be around other people and feel less isolated.
